events.subtitle: Take Cover Tour 2026 with Queens of the Stone Age + Mannequin Pussy
events.factual_description: Foo Fighters' Take Cover Tour 2026 at Nationals Park in Washington, DC, with Queens of the Stone Age and Mannequin Pussy. The official venue lists a 5:30 PM show time on August 17, 2026.

provenance.note: Date, venue, show time and bill verified against Nationals Park, Live Nation and Ticketmaster. Apple Music links verified as exact album pages.

en.why_it_matters: This is not just another stadium stop. Dave Grohl's deep DC-area lineage gives a Washington Foo Fighters show local cultural weight, and Queens of the Stone Age turns the bill into a serious rock night rather than nostalgia logistics.
en.trip_verdict: Local S. Make room for it: the DMV connection and the bill are strong enough that this is exactly the kind of major rock date RADAR should protect.
